component.name: Snippets
component.summary: Save code snippets, plain text, and Markdown notes

description.p: Snippets is a local scratchpad for Linux. Keep the commands and fragments you reuse — pacman, git, ssh, python, rsync — write a plain text reminder, or draft Markdown. Search instantly and copy the body to the clipboard in one action.

ul.li: Write each item as code, plain text, or Markdown
Sidebar list with title, format tag (bash / text / md), and a one-line preview
Instant search across title, language, and body
Code mode keeps a language tag and a monospace editor
Markdown preview for headings, lists, emphasis, code, and links
Copy the body (toolbar, Ctrl+Shift+C, or Ctrl+C when nothing is selected)
New note (Ctrl+N) and delete with confirmation
Automatic save to your user data directory

description.p: Code, plain text, and Markdown notes with search and one-click copy.
